metadata.name: clearstone_solver_callback
metadata.description: Reference callback program for clearstone_core.flash_swap_pt. Settles a clearstone-fusion order atomically against the flash-borrowed PT.

instructions.name: on_flash_pt_received
docs: Invoked by `clearstone_core.flash_swap_pt` after it has sent `pt_out` PT
to the solver's PT ATA. Handler must ensure `token_sy_escrow.amount`
grows by at least `sy_required` before returning — core enforces this
on its side via I-F2.
`data` is a borsh-encoded `CallbackPayload` (see below).

accounts.name: caller_pt_dst
docs: Solver's PT ATA. Core just deposited `pt_received` PT here.
Fusion.fill will move it to maker's PT ATA.

accounts.name: token_sy_escrow
docs: Market's SY escrow. Callback must top it up by `sy_required`.

accounts.name: mint_sy
docs: SY mint — used for `transfer_checked`.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Solver signs the outer tx; their signature is propagated here via CPI.

accounts.name: core_token_program
docs: Token program for the SY-escrow repay leg.

accounts.name: taker_src_ata
docs: Solver's src ATA. Fusion will credit it by the pulled amount.
This is where we pull our SY repayment from at the end.

instructions.name: on_flash_sy_received
docs: Sell-PT mirror: invoked by `clearstone_core.flash_swap_sy` after it has
sent `sy_received` SY to the solver's SY ATA. Handler must ensure
`token_pt_escrow.amount` grows by at least `pt_required` before
returning — core enforces this via I-F2 on the PT side.
`data` is the same `CallbackPayload` shape as the buy-side; the
fusion order this time has `src_mint = mint_pt`, `dst_mint = mint_sy`.

accounts.name: caller_sy_dst
docs: Solver's SY ATA. Core just deposited `sy_received` SY here.
Fusion.fill will debit it to deliver SY to the maker.

accounts.name: token_pt_escrow
docs: Market's PT escrow. Callback must top it up by `pt_required`.

accounts.name: mint_sy
docs: SY mint — used by the dst_mint guardrail check.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Solver signs the outer tx; their signature is propagated here via CPI.

accounts.name: core_token_program
docs: Token program for the PT-escrow repay leg.

accounts.name: maker_src_ata
docs: Maker's PT ATA — fusion.fill pulls PT from here.

accounts.name: taker_src_ata
docs: Solver's PT ATA — fusion.fill credits PT here, and the repay leg
debits it.

accounts.name: src_mint
docs: PT mint (= market.mint_pt for this direction). Used for transfer_checked.

accounts.name: dst_mint
docs: SY mint (= market.mint_sy). Validated against `mint_sy` by the
`UnsupportedDstMint` check.

errors.name: MalformedPayload
errors.msg: callback_data could not be borsh-decoded as CallbackPayload

errors.name: UnsupportedSrcMint
errors.msg: Reference callback only supports orders where src_mint == market.mint_sy

errors.name: UnsupportedDstMint
errors.msg: Reference callback (sell-PT) only supports orders where dst_mint == market.mint_sy

errors.name: InsufficientPulledSrc
errors.msg: fusion.fill pulled less src than sy_required — order underfills the flash
